prompt: While editing a workflow in VS Code, a developer wants unknown keys and broken indentation flagged before anything is pushed. What provides that?
explanation: Editor tooling — the GitHub Actions extension plus the workflow JSON schema — marks invalid keys and structure while you type. Pushing to watch the run fail also works, but it is the slow way to learn about a typo.

options.text: The GitHub CLI, via `gh workflow lint`
The GitHub Actions extension with the published workflow schema, validating as you type
The web editor on github.com only — desktop editors cannot validate workflows
Nothing — a workflow can only be validated by running it
